items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Public Administration, Psychology, Social Sciences, or related field
Experience managing complex operations, programs, or administrative functions
5+ years of program administration, operational management, or business operations experience
Demonstrated experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

The UCLA Division of Population Behavioral Health, part of the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior, is seeking to hire a full-time Business Manager to support the Children & Youth Behavioral Health Center of Excellence (COE), a partnership between UCLA and the Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health. The COE provides training, consultation, workforce development, and implementation support to providers serving children, adults, and families impacted by trauma, adversity, and behavioral health challenges throughout Los Angeles County.

You will oversee the daily operations of the Center of Excellence and play a critical role in ensuring program goals, contractual deliverables, and administrative objectives are met. Key responsibilities include:
Lead and execute operational plans to support Center initiatives and priorities
Oversee administrative operations to ensure efficient program delivery and achievement of contractual goals
Manage vendor, consultant, and subcontractor relationships, including procurement and contract administration
Monitor invoices, reimbursements, and financial transactions to ensure compliance with University and funding requirements
Partner with UCLA and County stakeholders to support program operations and service delivery
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
Familiarity with Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health and related County systems
Knowledge of budgeting, financial oversight, and business operations
Ability to build collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholders and teams
